t: A question about who speaks best
a: وَمَنْ أَحْسَنُ قَوْلًا مِّمَّن دَعَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا وَقَالَ إِنَّنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
p: Wa man aḥsanu qawlan mimman daʿā ila-llāhi wa ʿamila ṣāliḥan wa qāla innanī mina-l-muslimīn.
m: And who is better in speech than one who invites to Allāh and does righteousness and says, "Indeed, I am of the Muslims."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
